CODE
Art. 2.3.79. 
Effects 
Judicial separation as to property has effect from the date of the application, both as between the spouses and as against third parties.
A decision pronouncing separation as to property is null and void if the liquidation statement of the previous regime has not been drawn up by a notarial act within one year of the entry of this decision in the central register of matrimonial property agreements.
The time limit may be extended on application by the court that pronounced the separation as to property.
